    个人简历

    目前于杭州电子科技大学自动化学院攻读硕士学位。
    研究聚焦于非结构化环境下的机器人鲁棒感知 (Robust Perception)。 致力于通过结合深度学习与几何约束方法，解决激光雷达与视觉传感器在极端气象（雨、雾、雪、沙尘）下的数据退化问题，提升移动机器人的全天候环境适应能力。

    具备较扎实的工程实践能力与科研基础，能够围绕实际问题开展算法设计与系统实现。目前有博士阶段深造意愿，计划在机器人感知与自主系统方向进一步深入研究。

    欢迎对相关方向感兴趣的大家交流，也欢迎一起探讨问题与分享经验

    研究方向

    • 全天候环境下的鲁棒感知 (Robust Perception in Adverse Weather):
      • 多模态传感器去噪: 针对激光雷达 (LiDAR) 与视觉 (Vision) 在雨、雾、雪、沙尘环境下的退化复原 (Restoration) 与抗扰算法 (Noise Mitigation) 研究。

    Designed with ❤️ by a Robot Apprentice.
    Currently pursuing a Master's degree at the School of Automation, Hangzhou Dianzi University.
    Research focuses on Robust Perception for robots in unstructured environments. Working to solve data degradation of LiDAR and vision sensors under extreme weather (rain, fog, snow, dust) by combining deep learning and geometric constraints, improving the all-weather adaptability of mobile robots.

    Solid engineering and research foundation, capable of algorithm design and system implementation around real-world problems. Planning to pursue a PhD in robot perception and autonomous systems.

    Always welcome to connect and discuss related topics.

    Research Interests

    • Robust Perception in Adverse Weather:
      • Multimodal Sensor Denoising: Restoration and noise mitigation algorithms for LiDAR and vision under rain, fog, snow, and dust conditions.
